description: Analyze a multifamily real estate deal. Returns cap rate, cash-on-cash, DSCR, IRR, DFP Score (0-100), max offer price, and full financial projections. Use this when someone asks about analyzing a property, evaluating a deal, or running the numbers on a multifamily investment.

interest-basis.description: First mortgage interest basis. 365-360: interest accrues at rate x 365/360 (commercial / agency convention); 30-360: every month counts as 30 days. Omitted: the account's Settings default

second-mortgage-interest-basis.description: Second mortgage interest basis, same values

expense_source.description: Where monthly_expenses came from, e.g. T12, OperatingStatement, OM, Screen. Raises the confidence rating on the result.

income_source.description: Where monthly_income came from, e.g. RentRoll, T12, OM, Screen. Raises the confidence rating on the result.

monthly_expenses.description: Total monthly operating expenses in dollars (if omitted, 50% of income is assumed)

monthly_income.description: Total monthly rental income in dollars

property_address.description: Full street address. Drives the market data behind the DFP Score; without it the market component is understated.

scenario.description: Defaults to current: in-place numbers with DFP's default 7% vacancy. proforma applies forward-looking defaults (5% vacancy) and returns more favorable figures for the same deal. Pass it explicitly when comparing results.

name: analyze_deal
title: Analyze Multifamily Deal
